title: 월별 누적 매출
desc:
월별 매출과 함께 누적 매출을 구하세요. (월별 매출 = quantity × unit_price의 합)

열: month, revenue, cumulative / 월 오름차순
solution:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
)
SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;
hint: 먼저 월별 합계를 WITH로 만들고, 그 위에서 SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)를 쓰면 누적합이 돼요.
